facility.name: Dre's Locker Room Community Center
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Accredited,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 4313 CAVALCADE ST, HOUSTON, TX, 77026

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Operation and Program Director Annual Training 20 Hours Required: The director is missing  annual training must be relevant to the age of the children for whom the operation provides care, for the subjects of: Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reaction; Understanding building and physical premises, 2 hours in child growth and development.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Operation and Program Director Annual Training 20 Hours Required (26 TAC §744.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list: The operation last validated background checks on November 20, 2025. Note: this was corrected at inspection when the permit holder validated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list (26 TAC §745.651(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Each caregiver, operation director, program director, and site director Pediatric CPR: The director's CPR-first aid training expired August 2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each caregiver, operation director, program director, and site director Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §744.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone: The operation failed to submit a request for an initial background check for each person required to have one. 1 caregiver and 1 contracted driver both in ratio and without initial background checks.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you hire someone (26 TAC §745.621(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: The current fire inspection is expired and needs updating.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §744.3501(b))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving: One volunteer ended their role with the operation  on 5/8/25. Note: this was brought into compliance when the provider inactivated the background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving (26 TAC §745.651(1))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: Documentation of drills  was not provided to CCR for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §744.3559(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees - Transportation training: The director needs to complete 2-hours of transportation training as the operation offers that service.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees - Transportation training (26 TAC §744.1301(a)(7)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Two active ant beds and two metal posts are present on the playground. The metal posts were once supporting a tree and no longer being used for that purpose.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §744.2601)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: 1 out of 4 children's files missing Authorization to obtain emergency medical care and to transport the child for emergency medical treatment
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Physician Information (26 TAC §744.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Emergency Contact: 1 out of 4 children's records missing the address of another responsible individual (friend or relative) who should be contacted in an emergency when the parent cannot be reached.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Emergency Contact (26 TAC §744.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Admission Date: 1 out of 4 children's files is missing the admission date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Admission Date (26 TAC §744.605(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): 3 out of 3 staff missing form 2912,A Pre-Employment Affidavit for Applicants for Employment at Certain Child Care Operations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Training Hours (26 TAC §744.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Dates of Employment: 2 out of 3 staff missing date of employment. Note: this was corrected at inspection when the dates were added to the personnel form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Dates of Employment (26 TAC §744.901(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Daily Menu, Including All Snacks and Meals Prepared or Served: The operation offers dinner service to after schoolers with no posted menu. This was corrected at inspection when the director created a daily menu for the parent board.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Daily Menu, Including All Snacks and Meals Prepared or Served (26 TAC §744.401(6))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over: A tv that was sitting on a child size table in the main play space was not anchored to the table or the wall. Note: this was corrected at inspection when the director removed it and placed in the director office.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over (26 TAC §744.2601(9))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: The operation transports multiple children from two schools to daycare with no lists of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §744.3817(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The first aid kit is missing emergency guide, medical tape, thermometer and multiple size band-aids.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §744.2753(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: The transportation vehicle is missing the fire extinguisher.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §744.3817(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: The transportation vehicle is missing the first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §744.3817(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Information About Facility: The operation's name and telephone number must be clearly visible on the outside of the vehicle or kept inside the vehicle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Information About Facility (26 TAC §744.3817(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: The operation did not have the sign-in/sign-out log sheet for 10/28/24, 10/23-10/25/24, and 10/18/24.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §744.627(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The playground had a sharp and jagged piece of tile in the grass. Note: this was corrected at inspection when the director had the trash removed from the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §744.2601)

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: The operation transports children without keeping a copy of the Emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms for each child being transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §744.3817(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Initial background checks submitted - At the time you submit your application: At the time of inspection, the full background check has not been completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Initial background checks submitted - At the time you submit your application (26 TAC §745.621(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit: The kit is missing: guide, scissors, tweezers, thermometer, and multiple size  bandages.
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit - Incomplete Kit (26 TAC §744.2753(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Operating Times: The operation needs written operational policies covering all topics and made available to Licensing for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Operating Times (26 TAC §744.501(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation needs an initial fire inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §744.3501(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation needs a Sanitation Inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §744.2501(a))

occurrences.finding: Pest Extermination: Hornet nests are present in the active play space of the play ground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pest Extermination (26 TAC §744.2525)
